brief: Instagram post: 3 things to do after a non-fault accident
headline: 3 things to do after a non-fault accident
body: Check everyone is safe and call 999 if anyone is hurt.
Take photos and note names, plates and contact details.
Write down what happened while you still remember it clearly.

layout.structure: Single column on a flat slate background: small clipboard icon top left, large headline, three numbered points, an accent CTA button, then the guidance footer line.

regions.name: headline
regions.content: 3 things to do after a non-fault accident

regions.name: body
regions.content: Numbered list of the 3 body points, 40 px Open Sans Regular, generous spacing between points

asset.use: Small flat icon at top left, a quiet cue for a checklist. The headline is the focal element.

alt_text: Dark slate graphic with the heading '3 things to do after a non-fault accident', a three-step numbered checklist, and a 'Talk to us' button.
checks: Colors used are only slate, stone and signal from the guide
Fonts are Montserrat Bold and Open Sans Regular from the guide
Signal accent used once, on the CTA fill
Text sits on a flat color block, not on a photo
Tone is calm, plain English, second person, short sentences, no jargon, no legal threats
No result, amount or time promised; no 'no win no fee' or 'guaranteed'
CTA wording 'Talk to us' is from the guide's allowed list
Footer line 'General guidance, not legal advice.' included because this is a driver-advice post
No emoji, crashed-car stock photo, red warning triangle or exclamation mark
Headline is 8 words or fewer and 48 characters or fewer; each body point is 12 words or fewer
Margins are 64 px on every side; all regions are inside the canvas
open_questions: The guide is marked as a sample for a demo and is not the real client guide. Confirm the real colors, fonts and assets before publishing.
The guide gives no emergency number guidance. Confirm that '999' in point 1 is approved wording.
The guide gives no rule for recoloring clipboard-flat.svg on a dark background. Confirm whether it can be tinted stone.
The guide gives no logo, so none is placed. Confirm whether a logo or handle is needed.
The guide does not cover the Instagram caption, hashtags or link-in-bio wording.
